title: TAXNMY product
description: One product that can receive updates. Stored as products/<publisher>/<product>.yaml. The form of the key (rule TK2) and uniqueness (rule TK3) are checked by tools/lint.py, not by this schema. A product has no parent field: software does not need a parent product.

key.description: publisher/product, written with the writing rule. Never changes and is never reused.

publisher.description: The key of the publisher: whoever publishes the updates. Must match a file in publishers/.

name.description: The product name as the source writes it. Plain text: at most 100 characters, no control characters and no < or > (TAX-34).

kind.description: device: a physical product that carries firmware. operating-system: an operating system. software: software.

source.description: The page where the name and kind of the product can be read.

versions.description: Where the versions of this product are published (`source`). For a device, the versions are its firmware. A product of which the publisher publishes no versions, but says itself that it gets updates (rule TP1, TAX-67), has instead `published: false` and the page where the publisher says so (`updates`). When the publisher later publishes the versions, a change replaces both with `source`.

published.description: false: the publisher publishes no versions of this product. A reader sees it without opening a source.

updates.description: The page of the publisher on which it says itself that the product gets updates.

identifiers.description: Existing codes for this product, each with its own source.

aliases.description: Earlier or other keys of this product.

archived.description: The publisher has ended the product: it gets no more updates (rule TP10). Set only by a change that proposes it. The product keeps its key and its aliases.

resumed.description: The publisher took up an archived product again: it gets updates again (rule TP10). It replaces `archived`.

lifecycle.description: A page of the publisher, on the publisher's domain, that shows the change.

url.description: A page on a public address, over https only. The host is checked by tools/lint.py: no IP address, no localhost, no internal name (TAX-34).

identifier.description: Exactly one code (cpe, purl, gtin, winget or homebrew) and the source where it was found.

purl.description: A package URL, without version or qualifiers.

gtin.description: A GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13 or GTIN-14, written as a string.

winget.description: A winget package identifier, such as Mozilla.Firefox.

homebrew.description: A Homebrew cask or formula token, such as firefox.
